is_anopheles.evidence: The paper studies Anopheles sinensis, a malaria vector.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports kdr mutations at codon 1014 (L1014F and L1014C) in Anopheles sinensis (page 5).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper reports kdr mutation frequencies (88-100%) for four populations (page 5, Results section).

african_field_population.evidence: The mosquitoes were collected in Jiangsu Province, China (page 2, 3). The criteria requires an AFRICAN field population.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study involving field collection and transcriptome sequencing.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies four locations in Jiangsu Province: Xuzhou, Nanjing, Changzhou, and Wuxi (page 2, 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Samples were collected between July and September 2011 (page 2).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new field collections and transcriptome sequencing.

supplement.evidence: The required data (kdr frequencies) is provided in the main text.

assessment.summary: This study performs transcriptome profiling of deltamethrin-resistant and susceptible Anopheles sinensis collected from Jiangsu Province, China. It also reports kdr mutation frequencies (L1014F and L1014C) in these field populations.
